name: Uliana Sirotina
tagline: Engineering Manager | People Leadership & Hiring | AI-Enabled Teams
about: Engineering Manager focused on people leadership, hiring and AI-enabled teams, with 10 years in software engineering. Hired 13 frontend engineers at Uberall and kept a squad at zero attrition through an acquisition and a reorganisation. At SoSafe, kept a team delivering through two rebuilds, a PM change and a scope shift, while making AI part of how the team works and staying ahead of how fast the tooling changes.

experience.summary: Promoted from Senior Frontend Engineer to Team Lead within 4 months. Lead a cross-functional squad of 5 engineers (frontend, backend, fullstack) owning the Customer and User domains; 8 engineers led over 2 years, through two team rebuilds.
points: Rebuilt the team from merged parts (new PM, new designer, two developer pairs from different squads) and distributed ownership until holding only 4 of 16 epics personally

Led the team through a loss of its PM, a scope change to maintenance mode and two engineer resignations in the same week, while keeping delivery on track across three fronts: accessibility tooling, the self-service launch and customer domain fixes

points.text: coached a senior engineer out of underperformance in 7 months, moved a QA engineer into a junior backend role and promoted him to mid-level in the next cycle; managed one exit end to end, from calibration to separation.

points: Ran end-to-end hiring for 2 engineers and trained 3 colleagues to interview (including one first-time hiring manager) and authored hiring-process improvement proposals

points.lead: Built an AI skill for calibration
points.text: and structured performance feedback, aligned to SoSafe's Engineering Levels Framework and reused by managers across the company.

points.lead: Made the team an early AI adopter
points.text: (first to volunteer for tool trials, 2-day AI hackathon, AI now fully rolled out).

points: Connected the design system to Claude Design with the design system designer, enabling engineers (including backend) to design full UI/UX flows despite limited designer capacity; personally designed a Sales-facing test customer creation flow

Core team behind the customer self-service launch, owning delivery of the onboarding flow on our platform; self-service is now available for all low-to-mid tier customers, freeing CS from technical support to focus on quality consulting

Investigated why language handling was so complex and which parts of our architecture it touched, then planned and implemented the move from 2-digit to 4-digit language codes in our team, which owns the User and Customer objects; pushed back on shortcuts proposed by other teams with an estimate of ~2 months of rework per team across 5 teams

points.lead: Engineering partner for CS, CRM and Solution Engineering
points.text: on the internal platform: Salesforce integration, product provisioning and usability of internal UX flows (demo creation, pricing & packaging); led the Claude-assisted investigation of a pricing incident affecting hundreds of customers and the follow-up provisioning audit with Product Analytics that sized a seven-to-eight-figure ARR impact.

points: Introduced sprint-based planning, velocity tracking and explicit prioritisation; deliberately halved sprint load to reinvest capacity into architecture, technical planning, bug triage and pairing

points.lead: Shipped free-tier onboarding on the fixed release date.
points.text: Designed and implemented the customer onboarding flow for the product's free tier launch, covering a gap found late in planning.

points: Built product features in TypeScript, React, React Query and styled-components, with smaller improvements to the API
Restructured the team's API error handling and separated Sentry reporting from the shared company project, improving signal quality for frontend issues
Introduced a bug board and triage flow for the team

experience.summary: People lead for a cross-functional squad of 6 owning review management (aggregating Google Maps, TripAdvisor and partner reviews into one tool), and frontend hiring manager for the engineering department.

points.lead: Hired 13 frontend engineers across all teams.
points.text: As the department's frontend hiring manager, built the frontend hiring process and its documentation, and trained other engineers to interview.

points.lead: Held the team together through an acquisition, a reorganisation and repeated process changes:
points.text: zero attrition and unbroken delivery cadence.

points: Promoted one engineer to Senior, and mentored a backend engineer from another team into their first Team Lead role, advocating for them with leadership to make it happen

Introduced Scrum from scratch to balance a defect-prone multi-partner ingestion pipeline against new product delivery: two-week sprints with capacity deliberately reserved for incremental fixes, so quality improved steadily without pausing feature work
Developed features using ReactJS, Redux, React-Query, and Less, conducted code reviews
Improved onboarding documentation and process in the Engineering department
Led the creation of UI-component library (Theme UI, ReactJS)
